mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 1.0%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in continued accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 450000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the market anticipates fiscal stimulus and monetary easing, but the immediate economic weakness depresses corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions, as measured by the absolute level of PAYEMS (thousands of persons), consistently generate positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through sustained consumer spending and corporate hiring.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial output, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST > 1200 and GDPC1 > 16800, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 240), the market prices in aggressive monetary tightening and economic uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors shift to defensive assets.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
